title: Japan Cultural & Scenic Tour | Osaka, Kyoto, & Tokyo
highlights: Experience the best of Japan in one journey, combining ancient temples, cultural heritage, scenic Mount Fuji and Hakone landscapes, high-speed rail, and vibrant city life.
Explore Nara and Osaka’s iconic highlights, from the free-roaming deer at Nara Park and Todai-ji Temple to Umeda Sky Building and the lively streets of Dotonbori.
Enjoy a Shinkansen Bullet Train journey from Osaka to Tokyo, combining a comfortable high-speed transfer with a convenient way to travel between two of Japan’s most vibrant cities.
Explore Mount Fuji & Hakone, featuring Lake Ashi, Hakone Shrine, a Pirate Ship cruise, Hakone Ropeway, Owakudani, Lake Yamanaka, and Oshino Hakkai.
Enjoy a well-rounded Japan experience combining cultural heritage, scenic day trips, high-speed rail, and modern city experiences, with organised transfers throughout.
overview:
About the Tour:
Experience Japan’s cultural heritage, modern cities, scenic landscapes, and iconic experiences on an 8-day journey through Osaka, Kyoto, Nara, Hakone, Mount Fuji, and Tokyo. Begin in Osaka with leisure time before exploring Kyoto’s renowned temples, traditional neighbourhoods, gardens, and markets, including Fushimi Inari Taisha, Kinkaku-ji, Kiyomizu-dera, Arashiyama, and Gion. Discover Nara Park and Todai-ji Temple before returning to Osaka for panoramic city views and the lively atmosphere of Dotonbori. Enjoy a free day to experience Osaka at your own pace and savour its famous local cuisine. Travel to Tokyo aboard the Shinkansen and explore teamLab Planets and Ginza. Continue with a scenic Mount Fuji and Hakone excursion featuring Lake Ashi, Hakone Shrine, the Hakone Ropeway, Owakudani, and Oshino Hakkai. End your journey with Tokyo sightseeing, including Senso-ji, Tokyo Skytree, Meiji Jingu, Shibuya, and Harajuku, before your departure.

know_before_you_go: Carry comfortable walking shoes as the itinerary includes extensive sightseeing, temple visits, markets, and walking tours.
Keep some Japanese Yen handy for local purchases, meals, small expenses, and optional activities.
Temple and shrine visits require respectful attire and behaviour. Some sites may also involve stairs or uneven pathways.
Shinkansen travel involves handling luggage and moving between railway platforms, so keep your essentials easily accessible.
Weather can vary across Osaka, Kyoto, Nara, Tokyo, Mt. Fuji, and Hakone. Carry light layers and check the forecast before heading out.
Mt. Fuji and Hakone sightseeing is weather-dependent, and visibility of Mt. Fuji cannot be guaranteed.
The itinerary includes multiple full-day excursions, so start your days prepared with water, essentials, and comfortable clothing.
Some attractions may have specific entry timings or operational restrictions, which can vary depending on local conditions.
Keep your passport and important travel documents safely accessible throughout the trip.
On the departure day, allow sufficient time for the journey to the airport, check-in, security, and immigration formalities.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Kyoto Cultural Highlights Exploration
days.desc: Today, set out on a full-day sightseeing tour of Kyoto and discover the cultural heritage of Japan’s ancient capital. Visit Fushimi Inari Taisha, known for its rows of vermilion torii gates, followed by Kinkaku-ji, the famous Golden Pavilion. Continue to Kiyomizu-dera Temple and explore the scenic Arashiyama Bamboo Grove. Also, visit Nijo Castle, stroll through the traditional streets of Gion, and explore Nishiki Market, known for its local food and shops.

items.title: Kyoto Sightseeing Tour - Kyoto Sightseeing Tour

days.title: Nara & Osaka City Experiences
days.desc: Get ready & set out on a day tour covering the cultural highlights of Nara and the vibrant sights of Osaka. Begin at Nara Park, where you can see the city’s famous free-roaming deer, followed by a visit to Todai-ji Temple, home to the Great Buddha. Later, get driven to Osaka & enjoy a journey to the Umeda Sky Building for panoramic views of the city skyline. Continue to Dotonbori and experience its lively atmosphere, colourful signs, shops, and local eateries before getting driven to the hotel.

days.title: Free Time in Osaka
days.desc: Today, you can discover some of the city’s lesser-known experiences at your own pace. You can visit Sumiyoshi Taisha, one of Osaka’s oldest Shinto shrines, & admire its traditional architecture and distinctive arched bridge. Later, you can explore the Osaka Museum of Housing and Living, where recreated streets offer a glimpse into the city’s past. Also, you can experience TeamLab Botanical Garden Osaka and explore its outdoor digital art installations surrounded by the garden’s natural setting.

items.title: Osaka Museum Of Housing And Living
items.label: Suggestion

days.title: Shinkansen Journey to Tokyo | Visit to TeamLab Planets
days.desc: After checking out from your hotel, get transferred to the railway station to board the Shinkansen Bullet Train to Tokyo. Enjoy the comfortable journey as Japan’s high-speed train takes you to the capital. Upon arrival, visit teamLab Planets and explore its immersive digital art installations, where light, sound, and interactive spaces create a unique experience. Later, head to Ginza and explore its upscale shopping streets. Afterwards, get driven to the hotel and check-in.

items.title: Transfer in Bullet Train (Shinkansen)
items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train (Shinkansen) will be Provided

days.title: Mt. Fuji & Hakone Tour
days.desc: After check-out, set out on a full-day excursion to Mt. Fuji and the scenic Hakone region. Begin at Lake Ashi & visit the iconic Hakone Shrine, known for its torii gate standing along the lakeshore. Continue with a cruise aboard the Hakone Pirate Ship and enjoy panoramic views of the surrounding mountains. Also, ride the Hakone Ropeway to Owakudani and explore its volcanic landscape before visiting Lake Yamanaka and the traditional village of Oshino Hakkai. Later, get driven to Tokyo.

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour with Tokyo Skytree
days.desc: Set out on a sightseeing tour of Tokyo. Begin in the historic Asakusa district & visit Senso-ji Temple, Tokyo’s oldest temple, followed by a stroll along the lively Nakamise Shopping Street. Continue to Tokyo Skytree & enjoy panoramic views of the city. Pass by the Imperial Palace for an outside view before visiting the Meiji Jingu Shrine. Later, explore the vibrant neighbourhoods of Shibuya and Harajuku, known for their lively streets, fashion, and modern city culture.

items.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour - Sightseeing Tour of Tokyo

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: After checking out from your hotel, proceed to the airport for your onward journey. Allow sufficient time to complete airport check-in and departure formalities before boarding your flight. As your trip comes to an end, bid farewell to the destination with cherished memories of the places you explored, experiences you enjoyed, and moments you shared.
